title: Fix missing knobs on all module strips
body: ## Summary All module strip knobs were invisible because JUCE skipped calling `resized()` on child components when the editor size didn't change between `setSize()` calls. **Root cause:** When `kBaseHeight` was updated to match the initial `setSize(1100, 820)`, calling `applyUIScale(1.0)` → `setSize(1100, 820)` no longer triggered a second `resized()` (same size = no-op). The knobs are added by `setupModuleStrips()` AFTER the first `setSize`, so they never got laid out. **Fix:** Explicitly call `resized()` on each module strip after all setup is complete, ensuring knobs are positioned correctly regardless of whether the parent size changed. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Verify all module strips show their rotary knobs (AUTO-TUNE, GATE, EQ, COMP, MULTIBAND, DE-ESS, SATURATE, TAPE, WIDTH, DOUBLER, REVERB, DELAY, LO-FI, LIMITER) - [ ] Verify knob labels are visible and not clipped - [ ] Test UI scale slider — knobs should stay visible at all scale levels ### Notes This was a layout-only bug — no audio processing changes. The knobs were being created correctly but never positioned because their parent's `resized()` was never called after they were added. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/746dfe41f17940fbb3bc85bc14e118f3 Requested by: @elijahjfrierson-prog ---
